payload.as_is:
Pain 1 - the phone lane has no on-ramp. i8 built and mock-proved the from-away bless, but a real phone cannot be paired: pairing today means hand-creating an ntfy topic and hand-writing ~/.se/<project>/phone.json. So the shipped lane has never been exercised with a real device. Witness: the i8 ship review flags exactly this, the retro's field feedback names it as the one snag, and se.raid-phone-live-pairing stands open.

Pain 2 - a blessed or dismissed offer flickers back. When the owner acts on an offer in the panel, it clears but flashes back for one board tick before settling. It is brief but irritating, and it undermines trust that the action landed. Witness: the owner observed it live this session while blessing the i8b kickoff.

Pain 3 - a design-reuse iteration is front-heavy. Even when the design is already ruled, the iteration still walks the full systematic design-input states (M2 Understand, M4 Explore, M5 Decide), paying a design cost that has nothing left to decide. Witness: i8 and i8b both exposed this tax; se.decision-refine-mode records the owner's ruling this session to reduce design input for reuse iterations.
payload.raid_opened:
R1 (risk) - the QR encoder, vendored or hand-rolled, could add a bad dependency or bloat the one-click install. Owner: the driving agent. Trigger: the dependency-ship-review at M9 if a package is added (se.meth-dependency-ship-review).

R2 (risk) - realizing the refine strikes edits i8b's own seeded machine; removing M2/M4/M5 from a live iteration could break its walk or the executor. Owner: the driving agent. Trigger: when i8b switches its machine to the refine variant, before M2.

R3 (risk) - the offer-reappear fix targets a client poll race; a client-only fix may miss a server-side re-publish path. Owner: the driving agent. Trigger: the red-first reappear test at M7.

A1 (assumption) - topic-possession IS the authenticity model (se.adr-answer-authenticity): the QR carries the topic and the topic is the credential, so local-only encoding is sufficient. Owner: the owner (already ruled). Trigger: re-open only if the auth model is challenged.

D1 (dependency, owner-physical) - the live from-away pairing still needs the owner's real device to scan the QR and bless from away; that stays out of this unattended build. Owner: the owner. Trigger: after ship, the owner scans (se.raid-phone-live-pairing).
